product.name: Finance Claims on Day Zero
product.description: A service that allows healthcare providers to finance their claims immediately on the day they are made.

product.name: Choose Investors
product.description: A service enabling users to select investors for financing claims with guaranteed returns within 30 days and minimal risk.

product.name: Choose Insurance
product.description: A service that allows users to select insurance options to support claim financing and reduce associated costs.
